review_comment: The added recursive merge condition enables deep object merging without prototype pollution protection. Attacker-controlled objects containing __proto__ or constructor properties can pollute the Object prototype. Add property name validation to reject __proto__, constructor, and prototype properties before recursive merging.

The defaults function assigns user-controlled property names directly to the target object without validating for dangerous prototype properties. When the target property is null or undefined, the function assigns the value using the unvalidated key, allowing potential modification of Object.prototype if keys like '__proto__' are provided. Add property name validation to reject or escape special prototype property names before assignment.

The recursive merge function lacks depth limits, allowing user-controlled nested objects to potentially cause stack exhaustion. Add a maximum depth parameter and implement depth tracking to prevent unbounded recursion. Consider adding cycle detection for circular references.
